sources.applicability: Deletion records intent and performs runtime cleanup before removing repository state; recovery preserves outstanding work. GoldenHoop additionally requires original source collection and positive source-bound GC.

Deletion acceptance marks intent while finalization prevents removal before controller-owned cleanup conditions are satisfied. Applied as Collecting plus a durable operation, not completed cleanup from HTTP acceptance.

Connection acquisition timeout can include new connection establishment. A sanitized Store.open failure alone does not identify the underlying category; no production pool limit or timeout is relaxed.

boundary: Analogous upstream lifecycle and pool behavior guides the implementation; actual native KVM/profile proof remains a separate requirement.
